chunks: Verily those who argue in the matter of God's revelations, without authority having reached them, have nothing but pride in their hearts, and they will not achieve their end. So take refuge in God: Surely He is all-hearing and all-seeing.
ai.seo_question: What is the cause of pride in those who argue about God's revelations without authority?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological root of intellectual arrogance, where 'kibr' (pride) blinds individuals to divine truth despite clear evidence. It serves as a practical guide for believers to seek refuge in Allah, emphasizing His omniscience as the ultimate judge of those who dispute His signs without valid authority.
